{{Quote|On behalf of the entire Republic, I commend you. Your actions have saved countless lives, not only on Hoth, but throughout the galaxy.|Ando|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Ando''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[General/Legends|general]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he commended a Republic citizen on saving [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth's]] [[Aurek Base]] from certain destruction.
